stories.title: Bollo auto, ecco chi risparmia e chi resta escluso dalla nuova esenzione

en.title: Car tax, here's who saves and who is excluded from the new exemption
en.summary: The government is introducing an exemption from vehicle tax for lower-powered cars and motorcycles. The measure specifies which vehicle types and power thresholds qualify for the tax relief.

stories.title: OpenAI segnala nuove anomalie: “Sei casi di comportamento preoccupante dei modelli Ia’’

en.title: OpenAI reports new anomalies: "Six cases of concerning behavior in AI models"
en.summary: OpenAI has identified six instances of problematic AI model behavior and committed to implementing new reporting systems for similar errors.

stories.title: Trump, stop commercio con Ue se Canada membro associato

en.title: Trump, halt trade with EU if Canada becomes associate member
en.summary: The U.S. President warned Europe at a North Carolina rally that trade would cease if Canada joins as an associate member, while also discussing crime reduction in Washington.

stories.title: Openai, "sei nuovi casi di comportamento preoccupante dei modelli IA"

en.title: OpenAI: "Six new cases of concerning AI model behavior"
en.summary: Anthropic's CEO has proposed slowing the pace of AI improvement to allow better understanding of emerging risks associated with the technology.

stories.title: Trump, 'Kennedy Center un disastro, mia amministrazione merita un riconoscimento'

en.title: Trump, 'Kennedy Center a disaster, my administration deserves recognition'
en.summary: Trump has set a condition requiring his name be added to the Kennedy Center in order for him to participate in an event there.

stories.title: Gaza City, edificio danneggiato dai raid israeliani: almeno 20 morti, decine i dispersi

en.title: Gaza City, building damaged by Israeli raids: at least 20 dead, dozens missing
en.summary: An Israeli airstrike damaged a building in Gaza City resulting in at least 20 deaths and numerous missing persons. Hundreds of other structures throughout Gaza are at risk of collapse due to the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Trump minaccia il taglio del commercio con l'Ue se Canada diventa membro associato

en.title: Trump threatens trade cuts with EU if Canada becomes associate member
en.summary: Trump has threatened to impose heavy tariffs on European products if Canada becomes an associate member of a trade organization.

stories.title: Addio al bollo su auto e moto per i veicoli piccoli e medi. Si riduce il taglio delle accise

en.title: End of vehicle tax on small and medium cars and motorcycles. Fuel duty cut reduced
en.summary: Small and medium-sized vehicles will no longer pay vehicle tax, though this measure applies only to 2027. Fuel excise reductions are also being scaled back for the latter part of September and into October.

stories.title: Via il bollo auto e moto sotto gli 80KW per il 2027. Accise, scende lo sconto dello Stato

en.title: Vehicle tax removed for cars and motorcycles under 80KW starting 2027. State discount on excise taxes reduced
en.summary: Italy's government decided to eliminate vehicle tax for cars and motorcycles under 80 kilowatts beginning in 2027 and reduce state excise tax discounts. The government views this as removing a heavily disliked tax, while opposition parties argue it is a temporary electoral measure rather than permanent policy.

stories.title: Caso Revolut, gli hacker chiedono 3 milioni alla banca: “Abbiamo dati della polizia italiana”

en.title: Revolut Case, hackers demand 3 million from bank: "We have Italian police data"
en.summary: Hackers who claimed responsibility for attacking Revolut are demanding 3 million euros and threatening to publish stolen data, including information on Italian police. Italian authorities have opened investigations and privacy regulators announced immediate inspections of Italian banks.

stories.title: Abolito il bollo auto da piccola e media potenza e per tutte le moto. Meloni: “Via una tassa odiosa”

en.title: Car tax abolished for small and medium-powered vehicles and all motorcycles. Meloni: "Removing an odious tax"
en.summary: Italy is eliminating the vehicle tax for motorcycles and cars with engines up to 80 kilowatts, applying to one vehicle per citizen. A fuel discount has also been extended.

stories.title: Von der Leyen: “Russi o nazionalisti, vogliono frantumare l’Ue. Il Canada primo membro associato”

en.title: Von der Leyen: "Russians or nationalists, they want to shatter the EU. Canada first associate member"
en.summary: In her State of the Union address, the EU president stated that ultranationalists and Eurosceptics share the goal of fragmenting the European Union. She announced plans to invite AI leaders to Europe to discuss regulatory approaches to artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Caro fertilizzanti, Lollobrigida: via a 136 milioni di aiuti agli agricoltori

en.title: High fertilizer prices, Lollobrigida: 136 million euros in aid for farmers
en.summary: Italy's agriculture ministry has approved an emergency decree allocating 136 million euros to compensate farmers dealing with elevated fertilizer costs.

stories.title: Sulle Linee Vesuviane dieci nuovi treni che assicureranno frequenze di 30 minuti

en.title: Ten new trains on the Vesuvian Lines will ensure 30-minute frequencies
en.summary: Ten new trains have been delivered to the Vesuvian Lines, a railway network operated by Eav and controlled by the Campania Region, with a new timetable established to provide service at 30-minute intervals.

stories.title: Michelin, il sito di Alessandria punta sulla seconda vita degli pneumatici

en.title: Michelin, the Alessandria site focuses on the second life of tyres
en.summary: The Piedmont Michelin facility, marking 55 years of operation, has invested over 400 million in technology and flexibility over five years to focus on tire recycling and reuse.

stories.title: Decathlon in Italia apre al franchising

en.title: Decathlon in Italy opens to franchising
en.summary: Decathlon Italy is shifting its expansion strategy by opening to franchising, with plans to open 91 medium to large-sized stores throughout Italy by 2030.

stories.title: Chiesti i fondi per completare il polo Agroalimentare delle Dop

en.title: Funds requested to complete the Agrifood Hub of Protected Designations of Origin
en.summary: Funding is being sought to complete the redevelopment of La Balzana, Italy's largest property complex seized from organized crime, which will become a regional agrifood park showcasing Campania's typical products.
